title: Introduction to Customer Support
description: Learn how to help customers solve common problems.

lessons.title: Listen before you respond
lessons.body: A customer says, 'I cannot sign in.' First, acknowledge the problem and ask one clear question.
lessons.alt_text: A support agent listening to a customer
lessons.example: Try saying: 'I can help with that. What happens when you try to sign in?'

quiz.question: What should you do first when a customer reports a problem?
options: Acknowledge the issue and ask a clear question
quiz.answer: Acknowledge the issue and ask a clear question
